meta: Compare air conditioner and fridge specs with AI before buying: don't get steered to the priciest model by technical jargon.

muc.title: Steered to the priciest model
muc.text: Shopping for an air conditioner, the salesperson steers you to the most expensive one. Photograph the spec sheet and ask AI first.

muc.title: Jargon into plain words
muc.text: Photograph the spec sheet and ask AI to explain each line, like inverter or BTU capacity, in plain words.

muc.title: Side by side
muc.text: Send the specs of two or three models plus your room size and ask AI for a comparison table.

muc.title: Ask the seller back
muc.text: Ask AI to draft questions about warranty, installation fees and running costs. Check prices at several shops yourself.

muc.title: Decode one label
muc.text: Photograph the spec label of an appliance at home and ask a chatbot to explain the three most important lines.
